body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/4ee5318ed6bed42fcfa51d7f5bab017949293e2c.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Important[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The Doctor has been re-enabled in the 10th Anniversary Event queue.[/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://forums.bhvr.com/dead-by-daylight/home/leaving?allowTrusted=1&target=https%3A%2F%2Fus.v-cdn.net%2F6030815%2Fuploads%2FU55QUR7J9U7D%2Fbar-red.png"][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/U55QUR7J9U7D/bar-red.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; font-family: inherit; color: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-size: 15.4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-word; margin: 0px auto; padding: 0px; border: 0px; font-style: inherit; vertical-align: baseline; height: auto; display: block; position: relative; max-width: 100%; max-height: none; outline: 0px; width: 844px;"][/img][/url][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]Killer Add-on Updates[/b][/h3][p]The Slasher's add-ons[/p][list][*][p]Deputy's Badge (Very Rare)[/p][list][*][p]While in Omnipresent Evil, passing within 2m of a generator will cause it to explode. max-width: 100%; max-height: none; outline: 0px; width: 844px;"][/img][/url][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p][b]10th Anniversary Event - Black Banquet[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed the rarity of the Toothy Torte Cake offering from Very Rare to Common.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors were unable to Snap Out Of It against The Doctor when holding a Morsel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Fully infected Survivors were able to infect event interactables when playing against The Plague.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where only 3 Portals spawned in The Game map making one unable to be interacted with.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, rarely, it was impossible to interact with a Portal in the Family Residence map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Poison VFX remained on assets during the 10th Anniversary event.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Legion's power did not go on cooldown when throwing Poison as it was ending.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a blue stain would appear on the Survivor when consuming an Invisibility Morsel while being close to The Unknown.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a placeholder interaction sphere appeared around The Houndmaster's dog Snug when catching a Survivor that consumed an Invisibility Morsel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Poison Throw SFX would loop infinitely when the throw was canceled by the Dessert phase transition.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some Castlevania customizations were not playing the Collection music.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the cooldown of an audio node could miss a timer assignment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a further unintended longer delay between healing end & saved voice overs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed two issues causing Tomie's audio to persist in following trials against The Spirit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an incorrect voice line for The First when activating World Breaker mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing Killer and Survivor voice lines to be played in English, regardless of the Voice Language selection setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where audio distortion could be heard when escaping through the Exit Gate while the End Game collapse timer was almost done.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Characters[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some Survivors could pick up an item from outside The Lich's chest when positioned to the left, right, or backward.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the bottom teeth of Nancy Wheeler or Alan Wake (Rose Marigold Outfit) would clip inside the top lip when the Survivor attempts to 'Escape' while on a Hook.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Skull Merchant was able to deploy a Drone under a hooked Survivor. Causing the Drone to instantly be refunded.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Wraith's Suppression of the Red Stain and Terror Radius after Uncloaking were missing with the "The Ghost" - Soot Add-On.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors could be misaligned when getting pinned by The Slasher.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors with high ping were pinned to walls backward when moving away from The Slasher.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Mastermind could rarely softlock when performing a quick double dash with high ping.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors' shadows remained visible while The Slasher was inside the Omnipresent Evil.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Demogorgon became invisible when Teleporting to a Portal with a Survivor on top when the player was lagging.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Survivor kept the Flame Turret when in Dying State against The Xenomorph.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors traveled a much shorter distance when hit by the Killer Power of The Mastermind or The Slasher when both were at high ping.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Nightmare's Black Box Add-On was unable to apply the Linger Effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Slasher's Dirty Money Add-On consumed 2 tokens on a Jump Scare vault.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Cenobite could teleport under the map or inside the ground when teleporting to a Survivor using the Lament Configuration[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Deputy's Badge Add-On applied its regression effect on already regressing generators.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Deputy's Badge could activate during the Jump Scare teleport for The Slasher.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the closed guillotine doors in Grim Pantry had no collision.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Badham Preschool where the Vile Purge is blocked by an invisible collision[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Killer can't interact with the hatch[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Thompson House where screen goes black when blinking in part of the map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Toba Landing where The Houndmaster's Dog can't vault over a window[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Raccoon City Police Station where The Slasher can't reach and grab a survivor between two assets[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Trickster's Delusion where players can climb on top of the environment[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Crotus Prenn Asylum where grass is floating on top of a hill[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Badham Preschool where assets would too spawn close to each other and prevent players to navigate[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Fractured Cowshed where there was an extra collision on the stairs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Ironworks of Misery where The Plague's Vile Purge would be blocked by an invisible collision[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Trickster's Delusion where The Slasher could teleport into a blocker[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Mount Ormond Resort where The Demogorgon portal would float above the ground placed on the second floor of the building[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Realm of Coldwind Farm where the trap of The Trapper appears to be floating[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Trickster's Delusion where the introduction camera clips in The Houndmaster[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Mount Ormond Resort where the base of a totem is clipping in the snow[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Perks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Cross-Examination, could be triggered by 16 ranged Killer powers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Object of Obsession was unable to be activated when getting unhooked with Shoulder The Burden.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "Lend A Hand" prompt was displayed on the same Survivor after the charges were used.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Buckle Up activated with the perk Conviction, this was previously amended in error.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Misc[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Tome Challenge "Shared Task" was unable to be completed.[/p][/*][/list]
